frequency_question: How often do such announced sweeping tariffs actually take effect rather than being rescinded or replaced by negotiated agreements?
membership_rule: Includes explicitly announced, high-magnitude unilateral tariff threats on major contiguous or highly integrated trade partners where implementation is scheduled within a defined ultimatum period. Excludes standard WTO dispute resolutions or routine anti-dumping duties.
